subject.title: fix(qa): avoid retaining credentials after successful live runs

question: Should `qa-runner-runtime` expose `quiesce` as an additive transport lifecycle contract, or should the credential-ordering repair remain inside a narrower QA Lab boundary?
rationale: This is an API-boundary choice affecting future QA transport adapters; source evidence shows the hook is optional, but does not establish the intended long-term contract owner or external-adapter expectations.

options.title: Accept the additive lifecycle hook
options.body: Approve `quiesce` as the QA runner contract after the exact credentialed release-QA lane proves lease release following gateway shutdown.

options.title: Keep lifecycle sequencing local
options.body: Rework the fix so credential-aware ordering is handled within the existing QA Lab transport implementation without extending the runner contract.

recommendation.title: Accept the additive lifecycle hook
recommendation.body: Approve `quiesce` as the QA runner contract after the exact credentialed release-QA lane proves lease release following gateway shutdown.

likelyOwner.reason: Their merged transport-cleanup work established the current teardown invariant that this PR changes.
